print.name: Voron Trident Stepper Spacer
print.description:
Lower the stepper height so as not to lose Z when using coupler.
Scale Z to get the height to your liking. It's currently 22,5mm, which fits close to the Voron Trident's original stand.


Recommend printing with ABS.
